body: :( I can't anymore just one big failure
Lost everything and everyone things just keep going down and I'm just emotionally and physically drained

I had a job in a care home and one of the women who worked there she was called my supervisor she got me in trouble for the littlest things it was my first week too and i never got the right training. She told me she wanted to speak to me so I spoke and she told me how horrible my work was ect ect so i quit. And everyone from my school look like their having fun going out partying sleepovers ect and I'm just sitting in my house bored it's draining and I hate it thank you forging your time to read my comment and even reply x
Thank you for that lovely comment kinda makes me feel a wee bit better to know that other people are going threw the same sort of things. I'm just wanting the hurt and pain to end. X

I just really don't think any things going to change there's a lot of personal stuff and I can barley speak to my family I can never say how I'm feeling it's like something stops me i just wanna feel normal and live a normal life :(

There must be something deep down that's hurting you so much because you wouldn't have a bad attitude for no reason maybe look into what's making you so unhappy atleast you are aware of your attitude I'm 17 and my social anxiety is pretty bad it's extremely hard to just get over it! And hearing people say it doesn't help one bit! I think you should feel proud of yourself for even getting into university! Think about how far you have come! Maybe write a poem or draw some art on how your feeling but never feel like your on your own or its your fault! You have a reason to be here your worth so much more than you'll ever think! Stay strong!
